subject.title: Strengthen Vera TTS Norwegian dialect / accent

question: Should Android continue to rely on device-selected system TTS for Vera, or should OpenClaw add an Android-owned Norwegian voice/provider selection surface?
rationale: The requested outcome is qualitative and the issue proposes new selectable voices, dialect modes, and possibly third-party TTS providers; code inspection does not establish an existing contract that selects a Vera-specific Norwegian voice.

options.title: Validate and document system voices
options.body: Test installed Norwegian Android TTS voices and document the recommended engine/voice without adding a new OpenClaw preference.

options.title: Add an Android voice preference
options.body: Define a small Android-owned preference only if tested device voices expose meaningful, stable Norwegian choices.

options.title: Adopt a provider-backed voice path
options.body: Sponsor a separate provider integration only after choosing its privacy, credential, cost, latency, and offline-fallback requirements.

recommendation.title: Validate and document system voices
recommendation.body: Test installed Norwegian Android TTS voices and document the recommended engine/voice without adding a new OpenClaw preference.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Android Talk-mode work is the closest evidenced ownership signal for deciding whether this belongs in the mobile voice surface.
